connector.name: GodotLens
connector.registryDescription: Godot's own view of your GDScript project: navigation, diagnostics, engine API, scene checks
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package godotlens-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pzalutski-pixel account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
